method: Exit-poll groups, Governor race, all 15 states. Primary 2022 = AP VoteCast (all 50 states, same voter-file-based design the 2026 AP Voter Poll grew out of); 2022 CNN/Edison exit poll shown as a second 2022 source where it exists (9 states). Primary 2026 = CNN Voter Poll (SSRS); the AP/Fox feed of the same SSRS survey is shown as a cross-check (not independent). Swing = change in the group's D-minus-R margin (+ toward D). Δ share = change in the group's share of voters. Methods differ by year, so all swings are ~estimates. Registration = party of pre-Election Day ballots (UF Election Lab / state SOS). Early-vote age/race = voter-file counts (UF Election Lab).

gaps.TargetSmart/Catalist/L2: No public 2026 state turnout-by-age/race release found as of ~8:40 AM PT Nov 4; not used.
gaps.party_ballots: GA, MI, MN, OH, TX have no party registration. AK registers by party but publishes no ballots by party. NH publishes registration but not ballots by party for both years.
